title: Soul Snack #44: Unsplinter Your Personality
excerpt: In this illuminating Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explains that your intentions create your reality and what it means to live with a splintered personality.
bodyHtml:
In this illuminating Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explains that your intentions create your reality and what it means to live with a splintered personality.

The intentions of the different parts of your personality – a loving part and a frightened part – are always creating the experiences of your life, whether you are conscious of them or not .

The fundamental creative act is your choice of intention. Every part of your splintered personality – a frightened part and a loving part – has an intention. When you are not conscious of these parts, your reactions create painful experiences. Using your emotional awareness gives you the clarity to make a responsible choice. Choosing to align with a loving part of your personality is how you create authentic power .

By learning to pay attention to the physical sensations in your energy centers and to observe your  thoughts without judgment, you will see the intentions of the different parts of your personality. This is how you heal a splintered part. You make a responsible choice to act from a loving part, even while feeling the energy of a frightened part .

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (01:12) – The Deeper Meaning of Intention: Why your intention is the cause that creates the effect of every experience in your life.
  • (02:30) – A Splintered Personality in Action: A relatable example of the conflicting intentions between a frightened part and a loving part of your personality.
  • (03:50) – How Your Actions Create Your Life: Why you create painful experiences each time you act from the intentions of a frightened part of your personality.
  • (07:06) – The Key to Becoming Conscious: How using your emotional awareness to feel the physical sensations in your energy centers reveals your unconscious intentions .
  • (10:30) – Thoughts of a Frightened Part: Recognizing the thoughts of judging, analyzing, and comparing that signal a frightened part of your personality is active.
  • (12:29) – The Pathway to Authentic Power: How making a responsible choice to act from a loving part of your personality is how you create authentic power .

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Think back to a time when your words or actions didn’t align with what you thought your intentions were. What were the physical sensations in your chest, throat, or solar plexus? What thoughts ran through your mind – were they judgmental, fearful, or avoidant? Now pause. Revisit that moment and imagine responding from a loving part of your personality. What choice would you make instead? This is the sacred work of unsplintering your personality—moment by moment, intention by intention.
